lines.gurmukhi: ਓਨੑੀ ਮੰਦੈ ਪੈਰੁ ਨ ਰਖਿਓ ਕਰਿ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: onhee ma(n)dai pair na rakhio kar sukrit dharam kamaaiaa ||
lines.translation: They do not place their feet in sin, but do good deeds and live righteously in Dharma.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਨੑੀ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਤੋੜੇ ਬੰਧਨਾ ਅੰਨੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਥੋੜਾ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: onhee duneeaa toRe ba(n)dhanaa a(n)n paanee thoRaa khaaiaa ||
lines.translation: They burn away the bonds of the world, and eat a simple diet of grain and water.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਬਖਸੀਸੀ ਅਗਲਾ ਨਿਤ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਚੜਹਿ ਸਵਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) bakhaseesee agalaa nit devahi chaRahi savaaiaa ||
lines.translation: You are the Great Forgiver; You give continually, more and more each day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: vadiaaee vadaa paaiaa ||7||
lines.translation: By His greatness, the Great Lord is obtained. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੁਰਖਾਂ ਬਿਰਖਾਂ ਤੀਰਥਾਂ ਤਟਾਂ ਮੇਘਾਂ ਖੇਤਾਂਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: purakhaa(n) birakhaa(n) teerathaa(n) tataa(n) meghaa(n) khetaa(n)h ||
lines.translation: Men, trees, sacred shrines of pilgrimage, banks of sacred rivers, clouds, fields,

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੀਪਾਂ ਲੋਆਂ ਮੰਡਲਾਂ ਖੰਡਾਂ ਵਰਭੰਡਾਂਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: deepaa(n) loaa(n) ma(n)dalaa(n) kha(n)daa(n) varabha(n)daa(n)h ||
lines.translation: islands, continents, worlds, solar systems, and universes;

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਡਜ ਜੇਰਜ ਉਤਭੁਜਾਂ ਖਾਣੀ ਸੇਤਜਾਂਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)daj jeraj utabhujaa(n) khaanee setajaa(n)h ||
lines.translation: the four sources of creation - born of eggs, born of the womb, born of the earth and born of sweat;

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਮਿਤਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਰਾਂ ਮੇਰਾਂ ਜੰਤਾਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: so mit jaanai naanakaa saraa(n) meraa(n) ja(n)taah ||
lines.translation: oceans, mountains, and all beings - O Nanak, He alone knows their condition.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਸੰਮਾਲੇ ਸਭਨਾਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ja(n)t upaai kai sa(n)maale sabhanaah ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, having created the living beings, He cherishes them all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਕਰਣਾ ਕੀਆ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਭਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਤਾਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin karatai karanaa keeaa chi(n)taa bh karanee taah ||
lines.translation: The Creator who created the creation, takes care of it as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਜਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: so karataa chi(n)taa kare jin upaaiaa jag ||
lines.translation: He, the Creator who formed the world, cares for it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਜੋਹਾਰੀ ਸੁਅਸਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਅਭਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis johaaree suasat tis tis deebaan abhag ||
lines.translation: Unto Him I bow and offer my reverence; His Royal Court is eternal.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਆ ਟਿਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਤਗੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sache naam bin kiaa tikaa kiaa tag ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, without the True Name, of what use is the frontal mark of the Hindus, or their sacred thread? ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਨੇਕੀਆ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਲਖ ਪੁੰਨਾ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: lakh nekeeaa cha(n)giaaeeaa lakh pu(n)naa paravaan ||
lines.translation: Hundreds of thousands of virtues and good actions, and hundreds of thousands of blessed charities,

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਤਪ ਉਪਰਿ ਤੀਰਥਾਂ ਸਹਜ ਜੋਗ ਬੇਬਾਣ ॥
lines.transliteration: lakh tap upar teerathaa(n) sahaj jog bebaan ||
lines.translation: hundreds of thousands of penances at sacred shrines, and the practice of Sehj Yoga in the wilderness,

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਸੂਰਤਣ ਸੰਗਰਾਮ ਰਣ ਮਹਿ ਛੁਟਹਿ ਪਰਾਣ ॥
lines.transliteration: lakh sooratan sa(n)garaam ran mahi chhutahi paraan ||
lines.translation: hundreds of thousands of courageous actions and giving up the breath of life on the field of battle,

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਸੁਰਤੀ ਲਖ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਪੜੀਅਹਿ ਪਾਠ ਪੁਰਾਣ ॥
lines.transliteration: lakh suratee lakh giaan dhiaan paReeahi paath puraan ||
lines.translation: hundreds of thousands of divine understandings, hundreds of thousands of divine wisdoms and meditations and readings of the Vedas and the Puraanas

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਕਰਣਾ ਕੀਆ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin karatai karanaa keeaa likhiaa aavan jaan ||
lines.translation: - before the Creator who created the creation, and who ordained coming and going,

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਤੀ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਕਰਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak matee mithiaa karam sachaa neesaan ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, all these things are false. True is the Insignia of His Grace. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਏਕੁ ਤੂੰ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa saahib ek too(n) jin sacho sach varataaiaa ||
lines.translation: You alone are the True Lord. The Truth of Truths is pervading everywhere.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis too(n) dehi tis milai sach taa tinhee sach kamaaiaa ||
lines.translation: He alone receives the Truth, unto whom You give it; then, he practices Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨੑ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਚੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur miliai sach paaiaa jinh kai hiradai sach vasaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Meeting the True Guru, Truth is found. In His Heart, Truth is abiding.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਖ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੑੀ ਮਨਮੁਖੀ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: moorakh sach na jaananhee manamukhee janam gavaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The fools do not know the Truth. The self-willed manmukhs waste their lives away in vain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕਾਹੇ ਆਇਆ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: vich duneeaa kaahe aaiaa ||8||
lines.translation: Why have they even come into the world? ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਗਡੀ ਲਦੀਅਹਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਭਰੀਅਹਿ ਸਾਥ ॥
lines.transliteration: paR paR gadee ladeeahi paR paR bhareeahi saath ||
lines.translation: You may read and read loads of books; you may read and study vast multitudes of books.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਬੇੜੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਗਡੀਅਹਿ ਖਾਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: paR paR beRee paaeeai paR paR gadeeahi khaat ||
lines.translation: You may read and read boat-loads of books; you may read and read and fill pits with them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੜੀਅਹਿ ਜੇਤੇ ਬਰਸ ਬਰਸ ਪੜੀਅਹਿ ਜੇਤੇ ਮਾਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: paReeahi jete baras baras paReeahi jete maas ||
lines.translation: You may read them year after year; you may read them as many months are there are.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੜੀਐ ਜੇਤੀ ਆਰਜਾ ਪੜੀਅਹਿ ਜੇਤੇ ਸਾਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: paReeai jetee aarajaa paReeahi jete saas ||
lines.translation: You may read them all your life; you may read them with every breath.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਲੇਖੈ ਇਕ ਗਲ ਹੋਰੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਝਖਣਾ ਝਾਖ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak lekhai ik gal hor haumai jhakhanaa jhaakh ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, only one thing is of any account: everything else is useless babbling and idle talk in ego. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਿਖਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪੜਿਆ ॥ ਤੇਤਾ ਕੜਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: likh likh paRiaa || tetaa kaRiaa ||
lines.translation: The more one write and reads, the more one burns.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਤੀਰਥ ਭਵਿਆ ॥ ਤੇਤੋ ਲਵਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bahu teerath bhaviaa || teto laviaa ||
lines.translation: The more one wanders at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, the more one talks uselessly.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਭੇਖ ਕੀਆ ਦੇਹੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bahu bhekh keeaa dehee dukh deeaa ||
lines.translation: The more one wears religious robes, the more pain he causes his body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹੁ ਵੇ ਜੀਆ ਅਪਣਾ ਕੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahu ve jeeaa apanaa keeaa ||
lines.translation: O my soul, you must endure the consequences of your own actions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਨੁ ਨ ਖਾਇਆ ਸਾਦੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)n na khaaiaa saad gavaaiaa ||
lines.translation: One who does not eat the corn, misses out on the taste.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bahu dukh paaiaa doojaa bhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: One obtains great pain, in the love of duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਨ ਪਹਿਰੈ ॥ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਕਹਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: basatr na pahirai || ahinis kaharai ||
lines.translation: One who does not wear any clothes, suffers night and day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਨਿ ਵਿਗੂਤਾ ॥ ਕਿਉ ਜਾਗੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੂਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: mon vigootaa || kiu jaagai gur bin sootaa ||
lines.translation: Through silence, he is ruined. How can the sleeping one be awakened without the Guru?

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਗ ਉਪੇਤਾਣਾ ॥ ਅਪਣਾ ਕੀਆ ਕਮਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: pag upetaanaa || apanaa keeaa kamaanaa ||
lines.translation: One who goes barefoot suffers by his own actions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਲੁ ਮਲੁ ਖਾਈ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਾਈ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: al mal khaaee sir chhaaee paaee ||
lines.translation: One who eats filth and throws ashes on his head

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਖਿ ਅੰਧੈ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: moorakh a(n)dhai pat gavaaee ||
lines.translation: the blind fool loses his honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: vin naavai kichh thaai na paaee ||
lines.translation: Without the Name, nothing is of any use.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਹੈ ਬੇਬਾਣੀ ਮੜੀ ਮਸਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: rahai bebaanee maRee masaanee ||
lines.translation: One who lives in the wilderness, in cemetaries and cremation grounds

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dh na jaanai phir pachhutaanee ||
lines.translation: - that blind man does not know the Lord; he regrets and repents in the end.
